mapper.sql: select sleep_id, baby_id, start_time, end_time, sleep_type, duration_min, notes, operator_id, operator_name, rev, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_by_name, update_time, remark from nc_sleep
mapper.select: select to_char(start_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as label, count(*)::int as count, round(coalesce(sum(duration_min), 0)::numeric / 60, 1) as amount from nc_sleep where baby_id = #{babyId} and del_flag = '0' and end_time is not null and start_time::date >= current_date - (#{days}::int - 1) group by to_char(start_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD') order by label
mapper.update: update nc_sleep set start_time = #{startTime}, end_time = #{endTime}, sleep_type = #{sleepType}, duration_min = #{durationMin}, notes = #{notes}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_by_name = #{updateByName}, rev = rev + 1, update_time = current_timestamp where sleep_id = #{sleepId} and del_flag = '0' and rev = #{rev}
